[RTIM.14.13] **The oracle rule's name.** The compiler must name the rule
[RTIM.14.11] synthesizes for a `produces` assertion `$dstest_oracle_<t>_<i>`,
and the interpreter binds the `OracleEmit` / `OraclePublish` to the rule of that
name. `<t>` is the test's `test_id`, its 1-based place among the tests the
artefact carries ([RLOW.17.1]); `<i>` is the assertion's 0-based position, in source
order, among the assertions of that test's one `produces` section ([LTSL.2.3]).
Both are written in decimal with no leading zeros.

The name is synthetic ([LLEX.10.6.1]), so no
author-declared rule can bear it, and no source text refers to it.
